summary: Full Phase-1 E2E validation for RES site (bookings, certification finder, readiness assessment, industries, methodology, resources, unified leads, and new admin CRUDs). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_phase1.py — 24/24 pytest cases pass covering: public content endpoints (/public/industries [8 items], /public/methodology [7 steps], /public/resources [Capability Profile present], /public/assessment-questions [scores/weights not exposed]), public form submissions with persistence & unified-leads creation (Booking→Discovery Call lead + booking row; Certification Finder→cert_result + Certification Finder lead with suggestions/reasons/disclaimer/next_steps; Assessment→assessment_result + Readiness Assessment lead, score 0-100 with band + category_scores + gaps + recommendations + suggested_services; Contact Form enquiry also creates a Contact Form lead), admin flows (/admin/leads listing with 4 sources, filter by source, PATCH status='Follow-up' + note + next_follow_up, CSV export text/csv; /admin/bookings PATCH status='Confirmed'; /admin/dashboard exposes all new metrics — total_leads, total_bookings, assessment_completions, certification_completions, total_industries [>=8], total_resources, resource_downloads), and register_crud list endpoints for all 7 Phase-1 collections plus industry CREATE→public visibility→DELETE round-trip. Frontend Playwright: /book form success screen (book-success), industries grid (8 industry-card-* cards) + detail navigation, resources page (Capability + resource-download-* button), enhanced /services/audit-energy renders all 3 CTAs (/book, /contact, /capability-profile), /about shows methodology-section with 7 numbered steps, /certification-finder submit shows finder-result with finder-discuss-cta, /assessment submit shows assessment-result with score/band/category bars, floating whatsapp-button + sticky-book-cta on public pages, navbar 'Book Consultation' links to /book. Admin UI: login redirected to /admin/dashboard, dashboard cards visible with real numbers (Total Leads 13/12 new, Bookings 5/3 new, Enquiries 3/2 new, Assessments 3, Finder Results 3, Industries 8, Resource Downloads 0), /admin/leads shows 13 view-lead-* rows + export-leads + status/source filter with all 4 sources present, /admin/industries shows 8 rows with add-industries + edit/delete-<id> testids, sidebar has data-testids for all Phase-1 CRUD routes (methodology, certification-rules, finder-results, assessment-questions, assessment-results, resources, partners, events) — all routes load without errors while authenticated.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1000 lines with heavy per-feature blocks (bookings/finder/assessment/leads/dashboard) — consider splitting into routers/ modules once churn slows.
POST /public/bookings enforces a 60s / 3-per-IP rate limit which can cause 429s during automated tests or shared-office traffic; document this or make configurable via env.

Certification finder scoring is brittle: 'desired_outcome in framework upper()' uses substring match; e.g. desired_outcome='LEED' will also match 'LEED-EBOM' — fine, but 'IGBC Green Interiors' won't match 'IGBC'. Consider explicit code mapping.
Assessment: category_scores keys are dynamically taken from seeded questions; if a question has no options[picked].score field, it silently scores 0 — worth logging.

Frontend admin login page has no data-testid on the identifier/password/submit fields — added via input positional selectors during tests; suggest adding admin-login-identifier / admin-login-password / admin-login-submit testids for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created via Phase-1 form tests: 3 bookings (TEST FE Book/Book2 + backend test), 3 certification finder results, 3 assessment results, and ~13 unified leads across all 4 sources. Seed data left in DB for main-agent verification; TEST-prefixed and easily filterable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-1 e2e is fully green. New backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_phase1.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_phase1.py -v -o addopts=''` (default pytest.ini enables xdist which parallelises across gw0/gw1 and breaks the ordering-dependent leads tests; disabling addopts forces sequential run). data-testids catalogued: book-form/book-name/book-email/book-service/book-date/book-submit/book-success; finder-building-type/finder-name/finder-email/finder-submit/finder-result/finder-discuss-cta; assessment-form/assess-q{0-6}-o{0-3}/assess-name/assess-email/assessment-submit/assessment-result; industry-card-<slug>; resource-download-<id>; whatsapp-button/sticky-book-cta/methodology-section; admin-nav-*, admin-leads, view-lead-<id>, export-leads, admin-industries, add-industries, edit-<id>, delete-<id>. Assessment option testids are hidden radios — click via `el.closest('label').click()` in JS. Booking endpoint has per-IP 60s/3-req rate limit (HTTP 429).
